dialogue.speaker: Lark
dialogue.text: The missing crew refused to cut the sacred grove until their overdue wages were paid. Then they were ordered to report to the Rootbinder at the Overseer’s river works. Their pay was never collected.

dialogue.speaker: Alder
dialogue.text: Take the ledger. We can stop the cutting, but the roots must tell us what became of those workers.

withoutDain.briefing: Dain has fallen. Capture both logging camps to stop their crews, and recover the workers’ pay ledger from the northern ruin. His death does not answer what happened to the missing woodcutters; Lark must find evidence their families can hear without him.
hints: Capture both logging forts; standing in a marked grove does not stop the operation.
Search the northern ruin for the workers’ ledger.
Wolves cross woods easily. Boars and thorncaller staves fare better against armor.

intro.speaker: Lark
intro.text: Dain is dead. His patrol’s orders still do not tell us what happened to the workers.

intro.speaker: Alder
intro.text: Take both tool camps and recover their ledger. We still owe the families an answer.

victory.speaker: Lark
victory.text: The camps are ours and the cutting has stopped. The missing workers’ wages went to the Overseer, and their last orders sent them to the Rootbinder.

victory.speaker: Alder
victory.text: Dain will never hear their story. Lark, bring it back in a living branch. The families must be able to hear it for themselves.

withoutDain.debrief: The cutting operation has lost both camps. Dain died in the fighting; his death remains part of what happened. The ledger leads Lark to question the roots about the Rootbinder and the Overseer.
